name: Ghana National Identification Authority (Ghana Card)
description: Ghana's statutory National Identification Authority, which operates the national identity register and issues Ghana Cards using biometric identifiers including fingerprints, iris scans, and facial dimensions for public and private-sector verification.
notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

name: Uganda National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA)
description: Uganda's National Identification and Registration Authority, responsible for creating and managing the National Identification Register and issuing biometric national IDs to citizens and residents.
notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.

name: Huduma Namba / NIIMS (Kenya)
description: Kenya's National Integrated Identity Management System (NIIMS), commonly called Huduma Namba, intended to create a unique biometric-linked digital identity for citizens and residents across government services.
notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date; programme has faced privacy and legal scrutiny over biometric collection.

name: EU Age Verification App (EUDI prototype)
description: European Commission prototype age-verification application built on European Digital Identity Wallet (EUDI) technology, designed to allow users to prove they are over 18 without revealing additional identity attributes.
notes: Included as an age-verification system with a publicly reported security bypass; no identity-document data exposure was reported.
